topic: Badgey dissolution: dissolve the bespoke Badgey consultant runtime into atom/workflow-native primitives (gap-9dae9a60) — Badgey becomes one configured consumer

Phase 2 (consumer descriptor boundary) complete, commit d3b52cb, pushed. ConsumerDescriptor in consultant/descriptor.rs (name, id_prefix, intent_note_prefix, brofile_ref, scout_brofile_ref, action_kinds, proposal_kinds) with generate_id/parse_id/is_action_kind/action_note_kind/is_proposal_kind; Badgey descriptor + ProposalKind enum in badgey/vocabulary.rs. Generic runtime now badgey-literal-free: ConsultantId takes any prefix, ConsultantProposal.kind is a string (serde-identical), error wording neutral. Descriptor wired through tools: badgey_parse_id, persona/scout brofile resolution (8 sites), post-turn intent-note guard, synthesized bg-action-{invalid,failed,completed} composition, scout-mode prompt (prompt+parser share one grammar source per concern 3). Descriptors are code-owned constants — consumers select vocabulary, never define handlers in data (concern 4). Full gates green: check --all-targets, clippy, lint-concurrency, nextest full (3844). Remaining for Phase 3: atom backend for consultant turns, workflow ops for split apply, generic consultant_* MCP tools with badgey_* shims; scope-bind template + event→note mapping move when the turn-loop runtime splits out of tools/badgey.

Phase 3 core (workflow-visible apply/dispatch surface) complete, commit ef0a69d, pushed. Four consumer-agnostic MCP tools (consultant_proposals_list, consultant_apply_proposal, consultant_proposal_begin_apply, consultant_proposal_complete_apply) resolve consumer via code-owned registry consultant/consumers.rs + descriptor id-prefix enforcement; badgey_* proposal tools stay as pinned shims, wire format untouched. Shipped badgey-apply-proposal-arc (v4) and badgey-triage-channel-arc (v2) re-pointed to the generic tools with consumer="badgey" — apply arcs are now consumer-agnostic (concern 5 path established; installed copies keep calling shims until reinstalled). tool_docs gained 4 stanzas + consultant_ scan-prefix. Filed gap-271a5847: tool_docs source-scan tests are blind in CoW-seeded worktrees (compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) — caught live when the undocumented new tools initially passed coverage. Gates: full nextest green (3849), clippy 0, lint-concurrency ok (new list tool is async+run_blocking). Phase 3 remainder (separate session): consultant atom backend for turn lifecycle (concern 10 — needs async invoke path, current BadgeyAdapterRunner is a sync smoke stub), and the turn-loop runtime split out of tools/badgey (which unlocks generic exec/resume tools + scope-bind/event-mapping moving into the descriptor). Then Phase 4: state migration + shim retirement + docs.

Phase 3 COMPLETE (commits 33d0d32 turn-loop split, 87e8d73 atom backend, 0087af3 design status; all pushed). Turn-loop split: lifecycle now tools/consultant/lifecycle.rs with descriptor-parameterized consultant_{exec,resume}_internal/launch_exec/scope_bind/write_event; ThreadEvent vocabulary moved to orchestration/consultant/events.rs (ProposalEmitted.kind now string, serde-identical); descriptor gained display_name/agent_ref/exec_init_prompt/turn_budget_tokens — scope-bind header, thread naming, labels, budget all derive from it, byte-identical for Badgey; exec/resume results carry consultant_id + legacy consumer-keyed id; wrapper-command dispatch and intent post-processor explicitly consumer-gated pending a handler registry. Atom backend: AtomImplementation::Consultant{consumer} — invoke-per-turn (no consultant_id → open instance; with id+prompt → resume one turn), AtomHandle::Consultant records the turn, install validation requires registered consumer, provider capabilities route via consumer brofile, dispatch cost 1; ships system-defaults/atoms/consultant/badgey-consult.json (consultant/v1). Generic exec/resume MCP tools deliberately omitted — the atom backend IS the consumer-agnostic turn surface. Gates: clippy 0, lint-concurrency ok, nextest full 3850 green. Note: a stray workspace-wide cargo fmt was reverted (only deliberate changes committed). REMAINING = Phase 4: state_dir/badgey→consultant migration (or permanent legacy-path read), badgey_* shim deprecation/retirement, descriptor-selected handler registry to kill the name-gates, docs/badgey.md update + docs/consultant-runtime.md, design doc → implemented, then resolve gap-9dae9a60.

Rebased onto latest beta/blackbox-v2 (clean, no conflicts; gates green) and completed Phase 4 (4fd8ac7) + resolved gap-9dae9a60 as addressed (078a782). Slack bindings keep badgey_id field (data compat). ARC COMPLETE: all 4 phases + gap resolved, 9 commits on badgey-dissolution pushed, full nextest green throughout. Thread stays open pending operator review + merge of the branch into beta/blackbox-v2; resolve after merge.

Badgey dissolution complete and merged: beta/blackbox-v2 fast-forwarded to 078a782 (9 commits, phases 0–4) and pushed. The generic consultant runtime (orchestration/consultant: instance registry, proposal store, action journal, resume queues, ThreadEvent vocabulary, descriptor-parameterized turn loop) is atom/workflow-native — consultant_* proposal MCP tools + AtomImplementation::Consultant invoke-per-turn backend — with Badgey reduced to one configured consumer (BADGEY descriptor + vocabulary + ConsumerHooks::Badgey; badgey_* tools kept as pinned shims; legacy state_dir/badgey/ layout permanent by descriptor policy). gap-9dae9a60 resolved as addressed; design record at lifecycle: implemented; docs/consultant-runtime.md shipped.
